name: WALL-OSS 1.0 Lite
arch: Qwen3.5-based VLA with keyframe memory + residual refiner
note_en: Released for the RoboDojo benchmark; long-horizon memory.
note_zh: 为 RoboDojo 评测发布，具备长程记忆。

name: ABot-ER
arch: Embodied-reasoning VLM family with task-conditioned low-rank residuals
data: Spatial, temporal, affordance and planning data
note_en: Open embodied-reasoning family released Oct 2026.
note_zh: 2026 年 10 月开源的具身推理模型系列。

name: UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 / UnifoLM-ER-1
arch: World-language-action model; ER-1 brain on Qwen3-VL-4B
note_en: Partial weights released; more models and data promised.
note_zh: 部分权重已开放，其余模型和数据计划后续开放。

name: Magic-W0
arch: Structured world transition (3D geometry, 3D motion, future semantics) + layer-aligned action coupling
note_en: Control-oriented 3D world representation for WAMs.
note_zh: 面向控制的 3D 世界表征。

name: τ0-VLA
arch: Hierarchical VLA; world-model-guided test-time search over subtasks
data: 40,115 h heterogeneous real data + multimodal co-training
note_en: Spends extra compute on hard decisions at inference time.
note_zh: 推理时把更多算力花在困难决策上。

name: Skild S1
arch: Foundation model with in-context learning from one video
data: Human video + sim RL (Isaac Lab) + real data
note_en: Learns 10-minute tasks from a single video without fine-tuning (company claim).
note_zh: 看一段视频即可学会长达 10 分钟的任务，无需微调（公司数据）。

name: G0.5
arch: Single autoregressive decoder for reasoning + action tokens; learned cross-embodiment tokenizer
hwl: Galaxea R1 Lite; Galaxea R1 PRO; SO Arm 101
note_en: VLM stays the actor (no separate action expert); gated weights.
note_zh: VLM 本身直接输出动作（无独立动作专家）；权重需申请。

name: DYNA-2
arch: Video-generation world-action model, joint denoising of frames + action chunks
data: 1M+ h egocentric human video pretraining (no robot frames) + robot data
note_en: Moves from VLA to WAM; 1.55x task completion vs DYNA-1 (company claim).
note_zh: 从 VLA 转向世界动作模型；任务完成率为 DYNA-1 的 1.55 倍（公司数据）。

name: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0
arch: Autoregressive world foundation model initialised from Emu3.5
note_en: Unified token space for robot scene / video synthesis.
note_zh: 统一 token 空间的机器人场景与视频合成。

name: Xiaomi-Robotics-1
arch: Mixture-of-Transformers: Qwen3-VL + DiT flow head
note_en: Mobile manipulation in unseen environments out of the box.
note_zh: 开箱即可在陌生环境完成移动操作。

name: Pelican-VLA 0.5
zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心
arch: Unified VLA built on Pelican-VL brain
note_en: Attends to instruction-relevant contact regions before acting.
note_zh: 动作前聚焦与指令相关的接触区域。

name: MiniCPM-Robot
arch: On-device VLA with streaming context and 4x visual-token compression
note_en: Edge-friendly manipulation and tracking models.
note_zh: 面向端侧的操作与跟踪模型。

name: LingBot-VLA 2.0
arch: Qwen3-VL + MoE action expert, 55-D canonical action space
data: ~60k h: 50k h robot (20 configs) + 10k h egocentric human video
note_en: Adds head, waist, base and hand DoF plus predictive dynamics.
note_zh: 加入头、腰、底盘和灵巧手自由度及预测动力学。

name: Hy-Embodied-RxBrain-1.0
arch: Unified model interleaving text reasoning and flow-matched imagined frames
note_en: Plans by both describing and imagining each subgoal.
note_zh: 规划时同时给出文字步骤和想象的目标画面。

name: Gemini Robotics-ER 2
arch: Gemini embodied-reasoning model
note_en: On Google AI Studio; DeepMind calls it its safest robotics model (ASIMOV benchmark).
note_zh: 已在 Google AI Studio 提供；官方称在 ASIMOV 安全评测上表现最好。

name: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2
arch: On-robot Gemini Robotics VLA
data: Not disclosed; reported to adapt with <200 examples
note_en: Local model of the Gemini Robotics 2 suite (early access).
note_zh: Gemini Robotics 2 套件中的本地版（早期合作方）。

name: Gemini Robotics 2
arch: Gemini VLA with whole-body (legs, torso, arms, fingers) control
emb: Apptronik Apollo 2 with SharpaWave hands; bi-arm robots
note_en: Whole-body humanoid control and multi-robot collaboration; early-access partners only.
note_zh: 人形全身控制与多机协作；仅向早期合作方开放。

name: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA
arch: Mixture-of-Transformers VLA with RL post-training
data: 250k+ episodes / 10k+ h dual-arm teleop (~2k h released)
note_en: Full robot-learning stack from data to deployment.
note_zh: 覆盖数据到部署的完整机器人学习栈。

name: Cosmos 3 (incl. Cosmos3 Policy)
arch: Omnimodal world model: video, image, audio and action generation; Super / Nano / Edge
emb: Post-trained policies for DROID Franka, LIBERO
note_en: Open (OpenMDW) world model that doubles as a world-action backbone.
note_zh: 开放许可（OpenMDW）的世界模型，也可作为世界动作模型骨干。

name: WALL-OSS 0.5
arch: WALL-OSS successor; full training stack released
note_en: Zero-shot deployment without task fine-tuning (company claim).
note_zh: 无需任务微调即可零样本部署（公司说法）。

name: Qwen-VLA
arch: Qwen3.5 VLM + DiT flow-matching action decoder
data: Manipulation, egocentric human demos, sim, VLN, trajectories
note_en: Unifies manipulation, navigation and trajectory prediction in one VLA.
note_zh: 在一个 VLA 中统一操作、导航和轨迹预测。

name: MolmoAct2
arch: MolmoER VLM + flow-matching action expert via per-layer KV cache, OpenFAST tokenizer
hwl: i2rt YAM; Franka Research 3; SO Arm 101
note_en: Fully open; targets low-cost hardware.
note_zh: 完全开放，面向低成本硬件。

name: π0.7
arch: Steerable generalist VLA (language coaching, metadata prompts)
note_en: One model matches earlier RL specialists; offered via Pi API beta from Oct 2026.
note_zh: 单一模型达到此前 RL 专用模型的水平；2026 年 10 月起通过 Pi API 测试版开放。

name: VLA Foundry
arch: LLM→VLM→VLA in one stack; Foundry-VLA-1.7B and Foundry-Qwen3VLA-2.1B
data: TRI LBM data; evaluated in LBM Eval sim
note_en: Fully open from-scratch recipe, not just fine-tuning scripts.
note_zh: 完全开放的从零训练流程，不只是微调脚本。

name: Genie Envisioner 2.0 (GE-2)
arch: Interactive action-conditioned world model with built-in reward model
note_en: Minute-long stable rollouts; closed-loop RL inside the model (GE-Sim 2.0 weights on HF).
note_zh: 分钟级稳定推演，可在模型内闭环强化学习（GE-Sim 2.0 已上 HF）。

name: GR00T N1.7
arch: Cosmos-Reason2-2B VLM + DiT flow head, reasoning policy
data: Robot data + ~20k h EgoScale human ego video
hwl: Unitree G1+; Fourier GR-1; Franka Research 3
note_en: Commercially licensable open humanoid VLA (early access).
note_zh: 可商用的开放权重人形 VLA（早期访问）。

name: GO-2 (Genie Operator-2)
arch: Action chain-of-thought + asynchronous dual system
note_en: Plans a high-level action sequence before control; LIBERO 98.5% (company).
note_zh: 先生成高层动作序列再执行；LIBERO 98.5%（公司数据）。

name: GEN-1
arch: Multimodal model emitting real-time actions, trained from scratch
data: ~500k h human wearable data; base model uses no robot data
note_en: Claims 99% avg success on tasks where earlier models hit 64% (company claim).
note_zh: 称在此前模型 64% 成功率的任务上达到 99%（公司数据）。

name: Being-H0.7
arch: Latent world-action model: learnable latent queries, prior/posterior branches
note_en: Future-aware reasoning without generating pixels.
note_zh: 不生成画面也能进行面向未来的推理。

name: V-JEPA 2.1
arch: V-JEPA with dense predictive loss + deep self-supervision
note_en: Denser features; +20% real-robot grasp success over V-JEPA 2-AC.
note_zh: 更稠密的特征，真机抓取成功率比 V-JEPA 2-AC 高 20%。

name: MEM (Multi-Scale Embodied Memory)
arch: π VLA with short-term visual + long-term language memory
note_en: Adds long/short-term memory for tasks lasting many minutes.
note_zh: 为持续数分钟的任务加入长短期记忆。

name: GR00T N2 (preview)
arch: World action model architecture (DreamZero line)
note_en: Previewed at GTC 2026; NVIDIA says available by end of 2026.
note_zh: GTC 2026 预览，官方称 2026 年底前上线。

name: Xiaomi-Robotics-0
arch: VLM + DiT flow-matching action head, async execution
note_en: Open VLA tuned for smooth real-time execution.
note_zh: 针对实时流畅执行优化的开源 VLA。

name: RDT2
arch: 7B VLM + RVQ tokens, flow matching, distilled for real time
data: 10k+ h UMI demos across diverse families
hwl: Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e); Franka Research 3
note_en: Zero-shot deployment on new embodiments via UMI data scale.
note_zh: 依靠 UMI 数据规模实现新本体零样本部署。

name: DreamZero
arch: World action model on Wan2.1-I2V-14B, joint video + action denoising
note_en: 'World action models are zero-shot policies'; 7 Hz real-time; basis of GR00T N2.
note_zh: “世界动作模型即零样本策略”，7 Hz 实时；GR00T N2 的研究基础。

name: ABot-M0
arch: Qwen3-VL + DiT action expert with action-manifold learning
data: UniACT: 6M+ trajectories / 9.5k h from 6 public datasets
note_en: Open data pipeline + model; M0.5/M0.6 checkpoints followed.
note_zh: 开放数据管线与模型；后续发布 M0.5/M0.6。

name: UnifoLM-VLA-0
arch: Qwen2.5-VL-7B continued pretraining + action head
note_en: Humanoid manipulation VLA with spatial reasoning.
note_zh: 强化空间推理的人形操作 VLA。

name: Spirit v1.5
arch: Unified end-to-end VLA
data: Open-ended, goal-driven diverse data (not scripted demos)
note_en: Topped RoboChallenge Table30 (66.09), above π0.5, at release.
note_zh: 发布时在 RoboChallenge Table30 排名第一（66.09 分），超过 π0.5。

name: LingBot-VLA
arch: Qwen2.5-VL + flow-matching action expert (MoT)
data: ~20k h real data from 9 dual-arm configurations
emb: AgileX, Galaxea R1, AgiBot G1 and others
hwl: AgileX COBOT Magic; Galaxea R1 Lite; AgiBot G1
note_en: Pragmatic, cost-efficient open VLA with fast training codebase.
note_zh: 务实、低成本的开源 VLA，训练代码高效。

name: Helix 02
arch: S2 + S1 + new S0 learned whole-body controller
data: Teleop + human video + sim RL for S0
note_en: Full-body autonomy; S0 replaced >100k lines of hand-written C++ control.
note_zh: 全身自主，S0 取代了 10 万多行手写 C++ 控制代码。

name: Cosmos Policy
arch: Cosmos-Predict2-2B video model post-trained to output actions, future states, values
note_en: Video model as policy + planner; 93.6% on real ALOHA tasks (non-commercial license).
note_zh: 视频模型直接做策略和规划；真机 ALOHA 平均成功率 93.6%（非商用许可）。

name: 1X World Model (1XWM)
arch: Physics-grounded video model used as video-to-action policy
note_en: NEO predicts outcomes before acting; aims at tasks it never trained on.
note_zh: NEO 先预测动作后果再执行，目标是完成未训练过的任务。

name: XR-1
zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心
arch: VLA with unified vision-motion codes (UVMC)
hwl: X-Humanoid Tien Kung 2.0; Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e); Franka Research 3
note_en: Passed China's embodied-AI national standard test (per media).
note_zh: 据报道为首个通过具身智能国标测试的 VLA。

name: GR-RL
arch: GR-3 VLA + critic transformer, offline filtering + online RL
note_en: First real-robot shoe lacing via RL fine-tuning.
note_zh: 通过强化学习首次实现真机系鞋带。

name: GR-Dexter
arch: GR-3-style MoT VLA for bimanual dexterous hands
note_en: High-DoF dexterous-hand VLA (0.97 success in basic settings).
note_zh: 高自由度灵巧手 VLA（基础场景成功率 0.97）。

name: π*0.6
arch: π0.6 VLA + RECAP (advantage-conditioned RL from experience)
note_en: RL from experience more than doubles throughput on hard real tasks.
note_zh: 从经验中强化学习，难任务吞吐量提升一倍以上。

name: XPeng VLA 2.0
arch: Vision-to-action 'physical world model' without language bottleneck
note_en: Shared across cars, IRON humanoid and flying cars; open-sourcing announced.
note_zh: 汽车、IRON 人形机器人和飞行汽车共用；已宣布将开源。

name: SONIC
arch: Scaled motion-tracking transformer controller
note_en: Scaling laws for humanoid whole-body control; used as GR00T's lower body.
note_zh: 人形全身控制的规模化实验；后作为 GR00T 的下肢控制器。

name: Pelican-VL 1.0
zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心
arch: Embodied brain VLM (Qwen-based)
note_en: Large open embodied brain model; part of 'Huisi Kaiwu'.
note_zh: 开源具身大脑模型，“慧思开物”平台的一部分。

name: MiMo-Embodied
arch: Cross-embodied VLM for embodied AI and autonomous driving
note_en: One model for embodied reasoning and driving benchmarks.
note_zh: 一个模型同时覆盖具身推理与自动驾驶评测。

name: GEN-0
arch: Embodied foundation model with 'Harmonic Reasoning' (think and act concurrently)
note_en: Shows scaling laws with physical-interaction data.
note_zh: 展示了物理交互数据的规模定律。

name: BFM-Zero
arch: Promptable behavioral foundation model, unsupervised RL latent space
data: Motion data + off-policy unsupervised RL in sim
note_en: One policy prompted for tracking, goal reaching or reward optimisation.
note_zh: 一个策略可被提示完成跟踪、到达目标或奖励优化。

name: ACT-1
arch: End-to-end model: long-horizon manipulation + map-conditioned navigation
data: Skill Capture Glove data from 500+ homes, zero robot data
note_en: Trained without robot data; table-to-dishwasher in unseen homes.
note_zh: 不用机器人数据训练；在陌生家庭完成收桌到洗碗机全流程。

name: X-VLA
zh: 清华大学智能产业研究院
arch: Soft-prompted transformer encoder, flow matching
hwl: Franka Research 3; Trossen WidowX 250 S; AgileX COBOT Magic
note_en: SOTA on LIBERO / Simpler / RoboTwin with 0.9B params.
note_zh: 0.9B 参数在多个仿真评测上领先。

name: InternVLA-M1
arch: Spatial-grounding VLM (Qwen2.5-VL) + diffusion action expert
note_en: Spatial grounding pretraining then action post-training.
note_zh: 先做空间定位预训练，再做动作后训练。

name: WALL-OSS
arch: Qwen2.5-VL-based unified cross-level CoT, MoE flow / FAST heads
note_en: Language, vision and action output from one embodied model.
note_zh: 一个具身模型统一输出语言、视觉和动作。

name: UnifoLM-WMA-0
arch: World-model-action architecture (video world model + action head)
note_en: World model doubles as simulator and policy enhancer.
note_zh: 世界模型兼做仿真引擎和策略增强。

name: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5
arch: Gemini embodied-reasoning model with tool calling
note_en: High-level orchestrator; available via Gemini API.
note_zh: 高层编排模型，通过 Gemini API 开放。

name: Gemini Robotics 1.5
arch: Gemini VLA that 'thinks before acting' + Motion Transfer across bodies
hwl: Trossen ALOHA Stationary; Franka Research 3; Apptronik Apollo
note_en: Interleaves natural-language reasoning with actions; one checkpoint for 3 robots.
note_zh: 动作前先用自然语言推理；一个模型控制三种机器人。

name: GR00T N1.6
arch: Cosmos-Reason-2B VLM variant + larger DiT action head
data: N1.5 mix + more humanoid loco-manipulation data
note_en: Announced at CoRL 2025; native-resolution VLM, whole-body loco-manipulation.
note_zh: CoRL 2025 发布；原生分辨率 VLM，支持全身移动操作。

name: G0
arch: Dual system: G0-VLM planner + G0-VLA executor
data: Galaxea Open-World Dataset: 500 h, 150 tasks, 50 scenes
hwl: Galaxea R1 Lite; Galaxea R1 PRO
note_en: Open dual-system VLA plus single-embodiment open dataset.
note_zh: 开源双系统 VLA 及单一本体开放数据集。

name: MolmoAct
arch: Molmo VLM; depth tokens → visual trace → actions (action reasoning)
note_en: Fully open (weights, code, data) action reasoning model.
note_zh: 权重、代码、数据全部开放的动作推理模型。

name: Genie Envisioner (GE)
arch: GE-Base video diffusion world model + GE-Act flow decoder + GE-Sim
note_en: World model as policy, simulator and evaluator in one platform.
note_zh: 一个平台中世界模型同时做策略、模拟器和评测器。

name: EO-1
org: EO-Robotics (Shanghai AI Lab, AgiBot et al.)
zh: 上海人工智能实验室等
arch: Unified decoder interleaving vision-text-action, AR + flow
hwl: Franka Research 3; AgiBot G1; Trossen WidowX 250 S; AgileX PiPER
note_en: Interleaved embodied pretraining for reasoning + acting.
note_zh: 交错式具身预训练，兼顾推理与动作。

name: BeyondMimic
arch: Motion tracking + guided diffusion for task control
note_en: Highly dynamic motion tracking (cartwheels, sprints) with zero-shot task guidance.
note_zh: 高动态动作跟踪（侧手翻、冲刺），并可零样本引导到新任务。

name: Atlas LBM
arch: TRI-style diffusion transformer LBM, whole-body
note_en: One language-conditioned policy for locomotion + manipulation on Atlas.
note_zh: 在 Atlas 上用一个语言条件策略同时完成移动和操作。

name: Vidar
arch: Video diffusion model (Vidu) + masked inverse dynamics
data: 750k multi-view bimanual videos + 20 min target-robot data
note_en: Few-shot generalist manipulation from a video foundation model.
note_zh: 基于视频基础模型的少样本通用操作。

name: TRI Large Behavior Model (LBM)
arch: Language-conditioned diffusion transformer
note_en: Careful study: pretraining helps after fine-tuning, needs 3-5x less task data.
note_zh: 严谨的对照实验：预训练后再微调可减少 3-5 倍任务数据。

name: Skild Brain
arch: Omni-bodied hierarchical brain (high-level manipulation + low-level locomotion)
data: Large-scale sim + human video + real data
note_en: One brain for many bodies; partnerships with ABB and Universal Robots (2026).
note_zh: 一个大脑控制多种本体；2026 年与 ABB、优傲合作。

name: RoboBrain 2.0
zh: 北京智源人工智能研究院
arch: Embodied VLM (Qwen2.5-VL based) for planning, affordance, trajectories
note_en: Open embodied brain; RoboBrain 2.5 followed in Jan 2026.
note_zh: 开放的具身大脑模型；2026 年 1 月推出 RoboBrain 2.5。

name: GR-3
arch: Qwen2.5-VL + flow-matching DiT action head (MoT)
data: Robot trajectories + VR human data + web VL co-training
note_en: Strong long-horizon and deformable (clothes) manipulation.
note_zh: 擅长长程任务和衣物等柔性物体操作。

name: Being-H0
arch: Dexterous VLA pretrained on human hand video (physical instruction tuning)
note_en: Human hand motion as pretraining signal; Being-H0.5 followed (Jan 2026).
note_zh: 以人手动作作为预训练信号；2026 年 1 月推出 Being-H0.5。

name: WorldVLA
arch: Chameleon-based autoregressive action + image world model
note_en: Action model and world model trained jointly and help each other.
note_zh: 动作模型与世界模型联合训练、互相增益。

name: V-JEPA 2 / V-JEPA 2-AC
arch: Self-supervised video encoder + action-conditioned latent predictor
data: 1M+ h internet video; <62 h DROID robot video for AC
note_en: Latent world model used for zero-shot planning on new labs' robots.
note_zh: 隐空间世界模型，在新环境机器人上零样本规划。

name: SmolVLA
arch: SmolVLM-2 (layer-skipped) + flow-matching action expert, async inference
note_en: Runs on consumer GPUs / CPU; trained only on community data.
note_zh: 消费级 GPU 甚至 CPU 可运行，只用社区数据训练。

name: Redwood AI
arch: Vision-language transformer policy on NEO's onboard GPU
note_en: Mobile manipulation + whole-body for home tasks, ~5 Hz on-device.
note_zh: 家庭任务的移动操作与全身控制，机载约 5 Hz。

name: Gemini Robotics On-Device
arch: Compact Gemini Robotics VLA running on the robot
data: Gemini Robotics data; adapts with 50-100 demos
hwl: Trossen ALOHA Stationary; Franka Research 3; Apptronik Apollo
note_en: Runs locally without network; SDK for trusted testers.
note_zh: 无需联网在本地运行，SDK 面向受邀测试者。

name: GMT (General Motion Tracking)
arch: Adaptive-sampling MoE motion-tracking policy
note_en: One policy tracks a wide range of human motions.
note_zh: 一个策略跟踪多种人类动作。

name: Fast-in-Slow (FiS-VLA)
zh: 北京大学 / 智源 / 智平方
arch: Fast diffusion executor embedded inside slow VLM layers
note_en: Dual-system in one model; 117 Hz control.
note_zh: 在单一模型中实现双系统，控制频率 117 Hz。

name: UniVLA
zh: 香港大学 / 上海人工智能实验室
arch: Task-centric latent actions from video + VLA (Prismatic)
note_en: Learns cross-embodiment latent actions; low pretraining compute.
note_zh: 学习跨本体的隐动作，预训练算力需求低。

name: Optimus end-to-end policy
arch: Single end-to-end neural net ('video in, controls out'), FSD-derived
data: Teleop, then first-person human video from camera rigs
hwl: Tesla Optimus Gen2; Tesla OPTIMUS GEN 3
note_en: No paper; details from Tesla videos and press. Low confidence on specifics.
note_zh: 无论文，细节来自特斯拉视频和媒体报道，可信度较低。

name: GR00T N1.5
arch: Frozen Eagle 2.5 VLM + DiT flow head, FLARE objective
data: N1 mix + DreamGen synthetic data + human video
hwl: Unitree G1+; Fourier GR-1; Franka Research 3
note_en: Better language following; learns from human ego video via FLARE.
note_zh: 更好的语言跟随，并通过 FLARE 从人类第一视角视频学习。

name: DreamGen (GR00T-Dreams)
arch: Video world model fine-tuned on robot data + inverse dynamics for pseudo-actions
note_en: Synthetic robot data from video world models; 22 new verbs from one teleop task.
note_zh: 用视频世界模型合成机器人数据，从单一遥操作任务泛化出 22 种新动作。

name: π0.5
arch: PaliGemma VLM + flow action expert; predicts subtasks then actions
data: Heterogeneous: multi-robot, mobile manipulators in ~100 homes, web data, verbal instructions
hwl: Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e); Franka Research 3
note_en: Cleans kitchens and bedrooms in unseen homes; weights added to openpi (Sep 2025).
note_zh: 可在没见过的家中整理厨房卧室；2025 年 9 月加入 openpi 开源。

name: NORA
arch: Qwen2.5-VL-3B + FAST tokenizer
note_en: Small open generalist VLA.
note_zh: 小规模开源通用 VLA。

name: DYNA-1
arch: VLA with reward model for autonomous improvement
note_en: 24 h napkin folding at >99% success; commercial deployments.
note_zh: 连续 24 小时叠餐巾成功率超 99%，已商用部署。

name: Gemini Robotics-ER
arch: Gemini 2.0 Flash with enhanced spatial/embodied reasoning
note_en: Embodied-reasoning VLM; introduced the ERQA benchmark.
note_zh: 具身推理 VLM，同时提出 ERQA 评测。

name: Gemini Robotics
arch: Gemini 2.0 VLA backbone (cloud) + local action decoder
data: Large ALOHA 2 teleop dataset + web multimodal data
hwl: Trossen ALOHA Stationary; Franka Research 3; Apptronik Apollo
note_en: Gemini-based VLA; dexterous tasks such as origami folding.
note_zh: 基于 Gemini 的 VLA，可完成折纸等灵巧任务。

name: GR00T N1
arch: Eagle-2 VLM (System 2) + DiT flow-matching action head (System 1)
data: Real teleop + sim + human video + neural (generated) trajectories
hwl: Fourier GR-1; Unitree G1+; Franka Research 3
note_en: First open humanoid foundation model.
note_zh: 首个开放权重的人形机器人基础模型。

name: GO-1 (Genie Operator-1)
arch: ViLLA: InternVL VLM + latent planner + action expert
note_en: Latent actions from human video bridge to robot actions; weights opened Sep 2025.
note_zh: 用隐动作衔接人类视频与机器人动作；2025 年 9 月开源权重。

name: Cosmos-Reason1
arch: Multimodal LLM (ViT + LLM) trained for physical common sense
data: Physical common-sense + embodied reasoning SFT and RL
note_en: Physical-AI reasoning VLM; later the VLM inside GR00T N1.6/N1.7.
note_zh: 物理常识推理 VLM，后来成为 GR00T N1.6/N1.7 的视觉语言骨干。

name: UVA (Unified Video Action)
arch: Joint video-action latent with decoupled diffusion heads
note_en: One model = policy, forward/inverse dynamics and video generator.
note_zh: 一个模型兼做策略、正逆动力学和视频生成。

name: OpenVLA-OFT
arch: OpenVLA + parallel decoding, action chunking, FiLM
note_en: Fine-tuning recipe: 26x throughput, 97.1% LIBERO.
note_zh: 微调方案：吞吐提升 26 倍，LIBERO 97.1%。

name: Magma
arch: Multimodal agent model with Set-of-Mark / Trace-of-Mark pretraining
note_en: One model for digital (UI) and physical agents.
note_zh: 同时面向数字界面和物理机器人的智能体模型。

name: Hi Robot
arch: High-level VLM (PaliGemma) issuing language commands to π0
note_en: Hierarchical System-2 planner that handles interjections and feedback.
note_zh: 分层的 System 2 规划器，可处理用户中途插话和反馈。

name: Helix
arch: S2: 7B VLM (~7-9 Hz) + S1: 80M visuomotor transformer (200 Hz)
note_en: Dual-system humanoid VLA; ran two robots collaboratively on embedded GPUs.
note_zh: 双系统人形 VLA，在机载 GPU 上控制两台机器人协作。

name: DexVLA
org: Midea Group + East China Normal Univ.
zh: 美的集团 / 华东师大
arch: Qwen2-VL-2B + ~1B ScaleDP diffusion expert, 3-stage curriculum
hwl: Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e); AgileX COBOT Magic
note_en: Plug-in diffusion expert; laundry folding without task-specific data.
note_zh: 插件式扩散专家，无需任务数据即可叠衣。

name: π0-FAST
arch: π0 backbone, autoregressive over FAST tokens (DCT + BPE)
data: π0 mixture; FAST+ tokenizer trained on 1M trajectories
note_en: Frequency-space action tokenizer; 5x faster training than diffusion π0.
note_zh: 频域动作分词器，训练速度约为扩散版 π0 的 5 倍。

name: SpatialVLA
arch: PaliGemma 2 + Ego3D position encoding + adaptive action grids
note_en: 3D-aware spatial action tokenisation.
note_zh: 具备 3D 感知的空间动作分词。

name: GraspVLA
arch: VLM + flow-matching action expert, progressive action generation
note_en: Zero-shot sim-to-real grasping foundation model; part of AstraBrain.
note_zh: 零样本仿真到真机的抓取基础模型，银河星脑的一部分。

name: Cosmos WFM (Predict 1)
arch: Diffusion and autoregressive video world models + tokenizers
note_en: Open world foundation models for synthetic data and policy evaluation.
note_zh: 开放的世界基础模型，用于合成数据和策略评测。

name: Meta Motivo
arch: Behavioral foundation model (forward-backward representations)
data: Unlabelled motion data + online RL in sim
note_en: Zero-shot promptable whole-body control; simulation only.
note_zh: 零样本可提示的全身控制，仅仿真。

name: ExBody2
arch: Teacher-student RL expressive whole-body tracking
note_en: Expressive, robust humanoid motion imitation.
note_zh: 高表现力、鲁棒的人形动作模仿。

name: Emma-X
arch: OpenVLA-based, grounded chain-of-thought + look-ahead spatial reasoning
note_en: Grounded CoT reasoning for VLAs.
note_zh: 为 VLA 加入可定位的思维链推理。

name: ERA-42
arch: End-to-end native robot model fusing vision, language, touch, pose
note_en: Controls 5-finger hands across 100+ tasks; based on Tsinghua work.
note_zh: 控制五指灵巧手完成 100 多种任务，源于清华团队。

name: CogACT
zh: 微软亚洲研究院 / 清华
arch: Prismatic VLM (cognition) + diffusion action transformer
note_en: VLM + separate diffusion action module; common later template.
note_zh: VLM 与独立扩散动作模块解耦，后来成为常见模板。

name: π0
arch: PaliGemma 3B VLM + 300M flow-matching action expert
data: ~10k h on 7 robot configs (68 tasks) + OXE
emb: UR5e, Franka, bimanual ARX / AgileX / Trossen, mobile manipulators
hwl: Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e); Franka Research 3; AgileX PiPER; Trossen WidowX AI
note_en: Weights released in openpi (Feb 2025); de facto baseline for open VLAs.
note_zh: 2025 年 2 月在 openpi 开源权重，成为开源 VLA 的通用基线。

name: iDP3 (Improved 3D Diffusion Policy)
arch: Egocentric 3D point-cloud diffusion policy
data: Humanoid teleop demos in one scene
note_en: Humanoid manipulation that generalises to unseen scenes from one-scene data.
note_zh: 只用单一场景数据，人形操作即可泛化到新场景。

name: RDT-1B
arch: Diffusion transformer with unified action space; SigLIP + T5
note_en: Largest open diffusion foundation model for bimanual manipulation (2024).
note_zh: 2024 年最大的开源双臂扩散基础模型。

name: LAPA
arch: VQ-VAE latent actions from video + VLA pretraining
note_en: Pretrains VLAs on video without action labels.
note_zh: 在无动作标注的视频上预训练 VLA。

name: HOVER
arch: Multi-mode policy distilled from motion-imitation oracle
data: AMASS human motion retargeted, trained in Isaac
note_en: One controller unifies many humanoid control modes (root, joints, keypoints).
note_zh: 一个控制器统一多种人形控制模式。

name: GR-2
arch: Video-language-action GPT, web-scale video pretraining
note_en: Generative video-language-action model; 100+ tasks.
note_zh: 视频-语言-动作生成模型，覆盖 100 多个任务。

name: ALOHA Unleashed
arch: Transformer-based diffusion policy (task-specific)
data: ~26k demos across 5 hard tasks on ALOHA 2
note_en: Shoe lacing, shirt hanging with scaled data + diffusion.
note_zh: 靠数据规模加扩散策略完成系鞋带、挂衣服。

name: TinyVLA
org: Midea Group + East China Normal Univ.
zh: 美的集团 / 华东师大
arch: Small VLM (<1.4B) + diffusion policy head
data: No large robot pretraining; task fine-tuning
hwl: Franka Research 3; Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e)
note_en: Fast, data-efficient VLA without OXE pretraining.
note_zh: 无需 OXE 预训练、快速且数据高效。

name: HPT
arch: Heterogeneous Pre-trained Transformer: embodiment stems + shared trunk
note_en: Scaling study of proprioception + vision pretraining across bodies.
note_zh: 跨本体本体感知+视觉预训练的规模研究。

name: 1X World Model (v0)
arch: Action-conditioned video generation model
data: EVE / NEO robot logs; open challenge dataset
note_en: Learned simulator for policy evaluation; public world-model challenge.
note_zh: 用于策略评测的学习型模拟器，并举办公开挑战赛。

name: CrossFormer
arch: Transformer policy with embodiment-specific readout heads
note_en: One policy for manipulation, navigation, locomotion and flight.
note_zh: 一个策略同时覆盖操作、导航、行走和飞行。

name: RVT-2
arch: Multi-view virtual-image transformer, coarse-to-fine
note_en: High-precision manipulation from ~10 demos.
note_zh: 约 10 次示教即可完成高精度操作。

name: OpenVLA
arch: Prismatic VLM (DINOv2 + SigLIP → Llama 2 7B)
note_en: Open 7B VLA that beat 55B RT-2-X; the field's fine-tuning baseline.
note_zh: 7B 开源 VLA，超过 55B 的 RT-2-X，成为微调基线。

name: OmniH2O
arch: Teacher-student RL whole-body tracking policy
note_en: Universal whole-body teleop + learning interface for humanoids.
note_zh: 通用的人形全身遥操作与学习接口。

name: HumanPlus
arch: Humanoid Shadowing Transformer (RL, low level) + Humanoid Imitation Transformer
data: AMASS (40 h) for shadowing + ~40 demos per skill
emb: Custom humanoid on Unitree H1 base
note_en: Real-time human shadowing to collect and learn humanoid skills.
note_zh: 实时模仿人体动作，用于人形技能采集与学习。

name: BAKU
arch: Transformer trunk with FiLM + action chunking head
note_en: Efficient multi-task imitation architecture.
note_zh: 高效的多任务模仿学习架构。

name: Octo
arch: Transformer with diffusion head; language or goal-image conditioning
note_en: Small, fine-tunable open generalist policy.
note_zh: 小巧、易微调的开源通用策略。

name: RFM-1
arch: Multimodal any-to-any autoregressive transformer (text, image, video, actions)
data: Years of warehouse pick-and-place fleet data + internet data
note_en: Warehouse robotics foundation model; can predict video of action outcomes.
note_zh: 仓储机器人基础模型，可生成动作后果的预测视频。

name: DP3 (3D Diffusion Policy)
zh: 上海期智研究院 / 清华
arch: Point-cloud encoder + diffusion policy
note_en: 3D point clouds make diffusion policies far more data-efficient.
note_zh: 点云输入让扩散策略的数据效率大幅提升。

name: UMI (Universal Manipulation Interface)
arch: Diffusion Policy trained from hand-held gripper data
data: In-the-wild demos with GoPro hand-held gripper
hwl: Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e); Franka Research 3
note_en: Robot-free data collection that later scaled to RDT2, GEN-0, Xiaomi-Robotics-1.
note_zh: 无需机器人的数据采集方式，后被 RDT2、GEN-0 等放大使用。

name: 3D Diffuser Actor
arch: 3D scene tokens + diffusion over end-effector trajectories
note_en: Combines 3D scene representations with diffusion policies.
note_zh: 把 3D 场景表征与扩散策略结合。

name: Mobile ALOHA
arch: ACT / Diffusion Policy co-trained with static ALOHA data
data: 50 demos per task + static ALOHA co-training
note_en: Whole-body teleop for mobile bimanual chores (cooking, cleaning).
note_zh: 移动双臂全身遥操作，完成做饭、清洁等家务。

name: GR-1
arch: GPT-style transformer pretrained on video prediction (Ego4D)
note_en: Showed large-scale video generative pretraining helps manipulation.
note_zh: 证明大规模视频生成预训练有助于操作。

name: RT-1-X / RT-2-X
arch: RT-1 / RT-2 architectures trained on pooled data
note_en: RT-1-X checkpoint released; the OXE dataset underpins Octo, OpenVLA and most later VLAs.
note_zh: 发布了 RT-1-X 权重；OXE 数据集是 Octo、OpenVLA 等后续模型的基础。

name: VoxPoser
arch: LLM writes code composing 3D value maps with VLM perception
note_en: Training-free LLM/VLM planning via 3D affordance maps.
note_zh: 无需训练，用 3D 可供性地图做大模型规划。

name: RT-2
arch: PaLI-X 55B / PaLM-E 12B VLM co-fine-tuned to emit actions as text
note_en: Coined 'VLA': web knowledge transfers to unseen objects and instructions.
note_zh: 提出 VLA 概念：互联网知识迁移到新物体和新指令。

name: RoboCat
arch: Gato-style decoder transformer with VQ-GAN image tokens
note_en: Self-improving: fine-tunes, collects its own data, retrains.
note_zh: 自我改进：微调后自己采数据再训练。

name: ACT (ALOHA)
arch: CVAE transformer with action chunking
data: ~50 demos per task on low-cost bimanual rig
hwl: Trossen ALOHA Stationary; Trossen ViperX 300 S; Trossen WidowX 250 S
note_en: Action chunking + $20k ALOHA rig popularised bimanual imitation learning.
note_zh: 动作分块加低成本 ALOHA 平台，带火了双臂模仿学习。

name: PaLM-E
arch: PaLM + ViT-22B, multimodal sentence embedding
note_en: Embodied multimodal LLM that outputs plans for low-level policies.
note_zh: 具身多模态大模型，输出交给底层策略执行的计划。

name: Diffusion Policy
arch: CNN / transformer denoiser over action sequences
hwl: Universal Robots UR7e-920 (formerly UR5e); Franka Research 3
note_en: Made diffusion the default action head for imitation learning.
note_zh: 让扩散成为模仿学习的默认动作头。

name: RT-1
arch: EfficientNet-B3 + FiLM + TokenLearner + Transformer
note_en: First large-scale multi-task real-robot transformer; anchor of the current wave.
note_zh: 首个大规模多任务真机 Transformer 策略，这一轮浪潮的起点。

name: VIMA
arch: Encoder-decoder transformer with multimodal prompts
note_en: Multimodal (text + image) prompting for manipulation; sim only.
note_zh: 图文混合提示的操作策略，仅仿真。

name: PerAct
arch: Perceiver transformer over voxelised RGB-D, predicts next keyframe
note_en: Multi-task keyframe policy in 3D voxel space.
note_zh: 在 3D 体素空间预测关键帧的多任务策略。

name: Gato
arch: Decoder-only transformer over tokenised text, images, joints
data: 604 tasks: games, VQA, captioning, real & sim robot stacking
note_en: One set of weights for Atari, chat and robot block stacking.
note_zh: 同一套权重同时玩 Atari、聊天和机械臂堆积木。

name: SayCan
arch: PaLM LLM scores skills x learned affordance value functions
data: Skill library trained on Everyday Robots data
note_en: LLM planner grounded by skill affordances; early high-level planner.
note_zh: 用技能可行性值函数约束大语言模型的规划，早期的高层规划方案。
